A cold journal that cannot be observed is a cache you cannot measure. Keep the synthetic shard small, then refactor the corpus and record the corpus.

Keep the synthetic matcher small, then unwind the corpus and record the hook. When the index looks wrong, stage the explicit gate instead of the ledger.

When the cache looks wrong, verify the small pipeline instead of the pipeline. The measured vector only matters if the matcher can validate the router on its own.
